title: Dhanashree Verma CONFIRMS Yuzvendra Chahal, RJ Mahvash's Relationship; Fans Ask 'Did Yuzi Cheat?' | Bollywood News - News18
text: Did Dhanashree Verma just confirm Yuzvendra Chahal and RJ Mahvash’s dating rumours? A clip of Dhanashree having a vulnerable conversation with Arbaz Patel on Rise & Fall has gone viral across Reddit. In the video, Arbaz told Dhanashree that he knows Yuzvendra Chahal’s current partner well. Instead of denying the cricketer’s new love, Dhanashree cautioned that she has a lot of tea to spill. Arbaz said in the video, “Abhi jiske saath hai main usko bohot acche se jaanta hoon." Dhanashree said, “Chodo, mujhe unki baat nahi karni." Arbaz continued, “Nahi, mujhe aisa sunne main aata hai ki aapne cheat kiya and all…" Watch the clip here: Dhanashree explained, “Voh toh phailayenge na… faltu baat… sab negative PR, isko neeche karo. Ek darr rehta hai na ki main na kabhi muh khol doon, toh pehle kaise dabaye insaan ko. Main bataungi na ek ek point toh…" Dhanashree’s remarks are being seen as a confirmation of Yuzvendra Chahal and RJ Mahvash’s romance. Some fans are even curious if Chahal cheated on Dhanashree, and they want her to speak her truth. One person wrote, “SPILLL MAN. That guy dragged her through mud; she should seriously expose him." Another comment read, “In this country, people treat cricketers as God, so anything against them is false. Anyway, it’s always easier to blame women, and Dhanashree said in the show she won’t say anything about it as she respects the relationship she had with him." Someone else wrote, “But isn’t it evident that Yuzi cheated on her? He was spotted at a hotel with RJ Mahvash even before the divorce happened. He is with her all the time. Surya Kumar Yadav’s wife supported Dhanashree." A comment read, “People always loved to blame women. I always loved Natasha and Dhanashree, and people are so vile judging their personal lives. I am an avid cricket fan, but the hate they got is immense, which is so heartbreaking. Both Hardik and Chahal are seen publicly with their girlfriends. Imagine the outrage if Natasha or Dhanashree went out with a man." However, some fans of the show are also miffed with Dhanashree. One person wrote, “Neither of them will ever accept their own shortcomings that lead to the failure of marriage. Better to not believe either version fully." Another person wrote, “I support a woman and all, but am watching this show since day 1, and it’s getting irritating now. Every day she talks about ke kitna bura hua mere sath ye woh, never goes into detail and is in full victim mode." Someone commented, “Inhi baaton ke liye toh aapko show main laaya gaya hai, Dhanashree." A comment read, “Both she and her ex-husband are dramebaaz." Another comment read, “I think she came on the show to clean her image, but it has just backfired and turned her supporters against her." Someone else wrote, “Everything is planned. She knows why she is talking about the divorce so much on the show." Meanwhile, as for Chahal and Mahvash, they have often been linked to one another. Even though the RJ had denied the dating speculations, fans were unconvinced as they were frequently spotted together, and Mahvash even travelled with Chahal’s team. Recently, even Chahal denied dating Mahvash. In a chat with Raj Shamani, Chahal denied dating Mahvash and said, “No, there’s nothing. People can think whatever they want to think." Chahal recounted how online speculation took a toll on both of them. “For the first time, when I was seen with someone, people started linking us right away." “Even though she clarified it, it was very hard for her. She was called a homewrecker… people said really nasty things. I felt terrible," he shared. Chahal said Mahvash had supported him during one of the darkest phases of his life, and he felt devastated to see her dragged into unnecessary controversies.
